messages.text:
The failure is from the root `@tanstack/react-router` export map: the Start server package imports `@tanstack/react-router/ssr/server`, but the pinned `1.120.x` root package does not expose that path while newer Router packages do.

I’m upgrading only React Router within the allowed `^1.120.20` peer range and keeping the older Start line that installs cleanly in this workspace.
